title: Membership Agreement Clause: One Resort Club Membership per Resort
content:
**Clause.** Resort Club Memberships of one person are combined per resort: a person holds at most one membership at a given resort's club, whatever its level. A membership is opened only if the person has no other membership at the same resort whose status is pending, active, frozen or notice given; a member who wants another level at the same resort changes level at renewal instead. Guest passes, complimentary cabana days and food and beverage minimums of memberships at different resorts are never pooled.

## What the clause looks at

- **The person** — the primary member on the memberships held.
- **The resort** — the resort code on each membership; memberships at other resorts do not count.
- **The status** of each of that person's memberships at that resort, as the membership record shows it.

The level of the existing membership makes no difference: a Fitness Club Membership at a resort counts in the same way as a Founders Resort Club Membership at that resort.

## Status table for an existing membership of the same person at the same resort

| Status of the existing membership | A new membership at that resort may be opened |
|---|---|
| Pending | No |
| Active | No |
| Frozen | No |
| Notice given | No |
| Terminated | Yes, so far as this clause is concerned |

A person whose only membership at the resort is terminated, or who has no membership there at all, meets this clause.

## Another level at the same resort

A member who already holds a membership at a resort and wants a different level there does not open a second membership; the member changes level at renewal instead.

## No pooling across resorts

Where one person holds memberships at two resorts, each membership's guest passes, complimentary cabana days and food and beverage minimum stand alone. Passes left on one membership cannot be used under the other, cabana days are counted per membership, and food and beverage charged under one membership does not count toward the minimum of the other.
